_comment: Confirmed honeypot clone fingerprints. A fingerprint is a (model name, EXACT timestamp) pair that a cloned honeypot disk image carries identically across many hosts. A real host pulls a model independently and gets its OWN nanosecond-precision modified_at (ollama) / created (openai), so an identical timestamp shared across hosts means one cloned image, not independent deployments. Each match adds one bogus point to the host; hosts are routed bogus-score-ascending (0 first), never hard-dropped. This is an EXACT-match denylist, never a pattern. Derived by clustering the graflex check snapshots: these 6 were each shared by 209-243 of 688 hosts (65% of the pool), versus singleton timestamps for real hosts. Reconstitutable: re-run the scorer over the snapshots any time you edit this file. Extensible: add a top-level "digests" block later for content-hash fingerprints if timestamps stop being enough.
